title: Device execution context and ABI profiles
summary: Tensor descriptor ABI v2 adds execution provider, stream/fence handles, sync policy and affinity. This describes coordination, not permission to dereference. ABI-qualified bridge metadata is currently proven only for linux-x86_64-le-lp64.
invariants: Do not copy x86-64 struct layouts/constants to AArch64/Windows without separate qualification.
Plain C char signedness is intentionally unspecified; use i8/u8/signed char/unsigned char.
Host-native scalar aliases do not make containing struct layouts portable.
